subject: Event financial onboarding + PO & vendor coding
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Site visit recap + next steps

Team —

Thanks for joining the site walkthrough at The Foundry this morning. High level notes: the main hall fits our 280-person target with theatre seating, back-of-house cold room for catering, and an AV rig that meets our needs with a single external AV vendor. The site sent over an initial estimate; I'm attaching the PDF.

Two asks to get finance-complete and vendor-paid before vendor confirmations:

1) Confirm spend cap for venue + AV + security: current estimate is $62,400. Can we set a working spend cap of $70k to allow small adjustments?
2) I need a PO (or series of POs) created with cost center mapping so we can commit deposits: venue deposit ($15k), AV hold ($8k), speaker honoraria pool ($10k), catering retainer ($6k).

Other notes: CaterRight needs our W9 and insurance waiver prior to final menu sign-off. Foundry asked for proof of insurance for day-of coverage (they provided the vendor insurance requirements in the estimate).

Attachments: [Attachment: foundry_site_estimate.pdf (PDF, 142 KB)]

Next steps: Laura — can you route to AP and confirm the proper cost center string? Ben/Marissa — please review honoraria split and confirm names/amounts for speaker payments so I can include it in the PO request.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Program Lead, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Site visit recap + next steps

Evelyn —

Thanks for the recap and for attaching the estimate. Quick responses:

- A $70k spend cap is fine as a buffer. Finance will create a single umbrella PO for the event and then issue sub-invoices tied to line items (venue, AV, catering, honoraria).
- Cost center: please use MK-REG-2026-Q3 for marketing regional events. If this is cross-regional spend, flag it and we'll add an allocation line.
- For vendor onboarding: we need CaterRight's W9 and proof of insurance before we wire the retainer. Can Marissa pull those from the vendor?

I'll draft the PO request but need the speaker list + honoraria amounts to itemize that line. Also confirm if Acme Sponsorships will offset any of the venue cost (they mentioned a $12k sponsorship credit). If so, we'll put the sponsorship as an external credit against the venue line and reduce the net PO accordingly.

Laura Bennett
Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Looping in the confirmed speaker list and proposed honoraria. I populated the attached spreadsheet with proposed amounts and whether each speaker requires a contractor payment vs vendor invoice. Notable: two keynote speakers are external contractors and need 1099 processing; three panelists are being paid through their company invoices.

Proposed honoraria summary (draft):
- Keynote A (external contractor): $4,000
- Keynote B (external contractor): $3,500
- Panelists (3 x $1,000): $3,000
Total honoraria pool: $10,500 (rounded in my earlier note)

Requests:
- Can Finance create a separate PO line for "Speaker Honoraria / Contractor Payments" so we can route external contractor payments through AP/1099?
- For AV split: Foundry will bill venue and AV together unless we provide vendor account info for external AV vendor. If we want AV on a separate vendor invoice, we need to add that vendor as a contracted supplier in Coupa (or whatever AP system we use).

Attachment: [Attachment: speaker_honoraria_sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)]

Ben
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Event financial onboarding + PO & vendor coding

Team —

Finance has created the umbrella PO and split it into the requested line items. PO number: PO-78932. Summary below:

- Venue deposit (The Foundry): $15,000 — PO-78932 line 10 — cost center MK-REG-2026-Q3
- AV hold (external AV vendor to be registered): $8,000 — PO-78932 line 20 — cost center MK-REG-2026-Q3
- Catering retainer (CaterRight): $6,000 — PO-78932 line 30 — cost center MK-REG-2026-Q3 (pending W9 + insurance)
- Speaker honoraria pool: $10,500 — PO-78932 line 40 — cost center MK-REG-2026-Q3 — routed for 1099/contractor processing when we receive completed contractor forms
- Contingency buffer: $30,000 held under PO-78932 line 90 (do not spend without Finance approval)

Net authorized spend under PO-78932: $69,500 (reflects $12,000 pending sponsorship credit from Acme Sponsorships — once confirmed we will adjust the venue line).

Attachments: [Attachment: PO-78932.pdf (PDF, 54 KB)][Attachment: vendor-stipend-invoice-instructions.md (MD, 4 KB)]

Action items:
- Marissa: please gather CaterRight W9 + COI and upload to the vendor portal. Once uploaded, finance will release the catering retainer.
- Ben: confirm final speaker payment types (contractor vs invoice) so AP can process 1099s or vendor invoices accordingly.
- Evelyn: confirm if Acme Sponsorships will sign the sponsorship credit agreement by EOD Friday so we can apply the $12k credit.

I'll ping AP to register the external AV vendor if you confirm the vendor name.

—Logan
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
